text: Does cracking your knuckles give you arthritis? Your finger joints are wrapped in a capsule of slippery fluid, full of dissolved gas. Pull the joint apart, the pressure drops, and a bubble of gas forms. That's the pop. That's why you can't crack the same knuckle again right away. You have to wait about twenty minutes. One doctor, Donald Unger, cracked the knuckles of his left hand for more than fifty years, and never his right. The result? Neither hand got arthritis. He won an Ig Nobel Prize for it. So, crack away. Are you a knuckle cracker? Tell us below.
